statusNote: Implementation complete for the revised scope: path/history selectors reach the Codex subscription JSON edit client, with MIME/bytes/order checked by the existing local validations. Original stage evidence below is historical. Live edit calls are not executed because the user limited live verification to one generated image.

modules.tool: packages/pi-codex-image-gen/src/tool.ts: reference images are collected before the progress update and the credential check (Codex order: request_for_call_args before emit_started/backend); edit plans call ImagesClient.edit(plan, images, signal)

formatDetection.method: content sniffing (image::guess_format equivalent) for the pass-through set only: PNG 8-byte signature, JPEG FF D8 FF, WebP RIFF….WEBP; everything else is 'other'
formatDetection.decodeCheck: every file is decoded through Pi's convertToPng(base64, 'application/octet-stream') (non-PNG MIME forces a real decode); null -> process error

conversion.passThrough: png -> image/png, jpeg -> image/jpeg, webp -> image/webp with the original bytes (observed byte-identical for sips-made fixtures)
conversion.converted: every other decodable format (gif, bmp observed) -> PNG bytes from convertToPng with image/png
conversion.fileName: <basename without extension>.<ext for the sent MIME> (anim.gif -> anim.png)
conversion.noSizeLimit: a 61.1 MB random-pixel PNG (4000×4000 RGBA) loaded and decoded in ~0.8 s with no local error
conversion.metadata: convertToPng applies EXIF orientation and drops ICC/EXIF for converted formats (FDD §9.11); pass-through formats are unaffected

historySelection.order: messages newest-first; blocks within a message last-to-first; stop at exactly N; reverse to chronological
historySelection.assistantImages: ignored (assistant content cannot carry images in Pi; Codex scans Message items of any role, so this is equivalent)
historySelection.encoding: history images are sent as recorded (bytes from the base64 data, recorded mimeType) without re-encoding, as Codex forwards their data URLs unchanged; file names image-<n>.<ext>
historySelection.deviationFromBrief: the brief asked to convert non-png/jpeg/webp history images to PNG; Codex does not re-encode history images, and FDD §9.11 gives Codex behavior precedence, so no conversion is applied

errorStrings.read: unable to read referenced image at `<path>`: <Node error message, e.g. ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '<path>'>
errorStrings.process: unable to process referenced image at `<path>`: The image format could not be determined | image decoding failed
errorStrings.history: requested the last <N> conversation images, but only <M> were available
errorStrings.note: collection errors are returned as the tool error without the `image generation failed: ` prefix, as Codex does; no request is sent and no file is written
